title: Why Your Car Pulls When You Accelerate
hook: Torque steer will yank your wheel.

script.narration: Torque steer will yank your wheel.
script.visual_search: driver hands suddenly turning steering wheel hard acceleration

script.narration: In front-wheel drive cars, unequal length drive axles send different power amounts to each front wheel when you slam the gas, forcing the car to pull sideways instantly.
